sentences.text: Bench: Suvra Ghosh 20.04.2023 rc/ct.no.10 Item No.31  WPA No. 6044 of 2022

Mr. Arindam Das  Mrs. Anushka Mahato ...for the petitioner  Mr. Goutam Sarkar  Mr. Goutam Malik ..for the UOI  Mr. Santanu Kumar Mitra  Mr. Mirza Kamruddin ...for the State  Mr. Amitava Chaudhuri  Mr. N. Roy ...for the respondent no.4
The State respondents intend to acquire land for construction of road for fencing over Indo-Bangladesh border and requested the petitioners to sell out their land for the purpose.
The consideration amount decided by the authority for the purpose was not accepted by the petitioner.

It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that the petitioners are agreeable to part with the property only if the land is acquired in terms of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and compensation is paid to the petitioners in terms thereof.
Learned counsels for the State-respondent and Zilla Parishad seek to submit report in the form of affidavit in this regard.
Let this matter appear under the same heading on 13th June, 2023.
(Suvra Ghosh,J)
